messages:
Maria P: quick q — for the SI co-sell routing on the new HW + marketplace bundle, do we prefer SI claims based on CRM owner or product-fit tags? need to lock before Fri AMA :calendar:
Aisha K: my vote = CRM owner when it's a named account. product-fit tags for open pipeline. can we gate on ACV?
Tom L: +1 CRM owner for >= $100k ACV. for <$100k use tag-based -> partner_co_sell_queue. keeps SI capacity reasonable.
Diego R: we already have a mapping script. proposed rule (pseudo):
```yaml
# routing prototype
if account.named and account.acv >= 100000:
  route: si_claim_queue
elif "hw-bundle" in account.tags and partner.enabled:
  route: partner_marketplace_queue
else:
  route: growth_cohort_queue
```
Priya S: 👍 question: who owns the handoff notif? marketplace-bot ok to ping #sales or should SEs own the initial outreach?
marketplace-bot: Automated claim created: ACME Corp -> si_claim_queue. claim_id=CLM-4821 :robot_face:
Aisha K: marketplace-bot should ping #partnerships + @si-oncall, and add a 48h SLA for claim acceptance (auto-escalate if not claimed).
Tom L: also add an overlap check: if an AE/SE is actively working the account (contacted in last 14d), auto-assign back to them and notify partner ops.
Diego R: will add the overlap check + SLA logic and open a PR in routing repo today: https://git.internal/redwood/si-routing/pull/123
Maria P: perfect — can someone draft a 1-pager for Fri AMA: bullets for mapping rules, SLA, notif flows, and escalation steps?
Priya S: I got this. will share draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
Tom L: thanks all — this will make launch smoother.
Maria P: will collect feedback and finalize before AMA. thanks!
